# ELITZE Agentic Security

ELITZE Agentic Security provides identity-aware security workflows for AI agents, MCP servers, tools, and sensitive execution paths. Only explicitly authorized integrations may connect; capability descriptions do not establish live connectivity.

## ELITZE website pages
- https://www.elitze.info/

## Product capabilities

These are product capability areas, not a claim that every control is deployed, connected, or verified in production.
- Security Graph
- Security Intelligence
- Policy Engine
- Guardrails
- Sandbox
- Kill Switch / containment
- Non-human identity
- Tool and protocol governance
- CI/CD security gates
- Evidence and audit persistence
- REO content integrity
- RIO reach and visibility measurement

## Security model
The security boundary is external to the agent. Identity, authorization, policy, credentials, data access, network controls, sandboxing and containment remain independently enforceable.

## Integrity
ELITZE does not treat unverified telemetry as live production data. Operational values must come from configured services and persistence. Unimplemented controls must not be represented as active protection.

## Machine-readable truth rule
Capabilities, rankings, metrics, customer outcomes and security states must be supported by real evidence. Missing source data remains missing; the system must not fabricate replacement values.
